fields.summary: Autonomous plan run, no owner. The planner read run resume's guard (internal/api/run.go, already exempting plan runs on a landed record), the daemon's Resumable accepted check (internal/daemon/pick.go, daemonPoll1), the inbox's skipped listing (internal/api/inbox.go) and ship-change.toml, and found rhiza ship land skips a change set already landed. It raised one question (served intent, plan-run scope given draft 01M6H5VQ, and the rule for which landed runs resume). The arbiter decided (landed-run-resume-scope): serve m4-runs-hold-up; cover non-plan runs only, leaving plan runs to 01M6H5VQ; a non-plan run on a landed change set resumes, by hand and by the daemon, when its journal shows it reached the land step; others stay refused with rhiza run abandon as next. Leaves planned: run resume continues such a run, the daemon resumes it headless, and the inbox stops listing it as skipped.
fields.title: Plan of 01M6J965: resume runs whose change set landed
